pages.text: The Nether is Incendium's: new biomes, piglin villages, a quartz kitchen with a chef in it, a reactor that still runs. Portals link up sensibly (Nether Portal Fix) so a portal in your town comes back to your town.$(br2)The Nether holds four Blueprints and the Inferno's altar. A mid-game place, not a shortcut.

The End is Nullscape's: islands, pillars, crystal peaks and shadowlands. Cataclysm's Ruined Citadel stands in its highlands with the $(bold)Ender Guardian$() inside.$(br2)What the Guardian keeps is the last chapter. See $(l:patchouli:tech/tier4)Tier 4$().

The $(bold)Ender Dragon$() is not the old one. Its island is rebuilt, its caged crystals are guarded, and it dives, burns and fires beams; at the very end it must be struck in the air.$(br2)Bring a crew, arrows, slow falling and a way down. Kill it together: the Hall of Heroes remembers who was there.
